name: Webmention Endpoint
description: Receive webmentions on your Digital Garden without editing its template.
author: Ian Henderson

settings.name: Webmention.io account domain
settings.description: Domain you log in to webmention.io with. Can differ from this garden's domain.

settings.name: Sign-in profile URL (optional)
settings.description: Only needed if this garden is the domain you sign in to webmention.io with. Your GitHub, GitLab or Codeberg profile URL; that profile must link back to this garden. Leave empty if you sign in with another site.
